title: Take That Back
description: Allows you to retract chat messages sent within a timeframe
body:
This mod allows you to add a delay between sending a chat message in chat, and the message being sent to the server, allowing you to 'undo' messages.

To retract a message, type `/takethatback` or use the `/ttb` alias. You will be informed in chat if this worked. # Settings You can completely disable and enable the mod ingame! To open the config menu, use the command `/takethatback config`. You can also set the delay with the command `/takethatback <0-20>` The delay defaults to 1 second, however it's recommended you customise it.
